summary: Fixed the ledger package (rounding half away from zero via core helpers, negative amount formatting, fiscal quarters, rate file ranges/column names and 6-month look-back-only rate lookup, header-over-dialect layout, reversals booked and valued at the original's date, per-entry rounded sums in reports, tax rule effective dates and return quarters, writer jurisdiction, HTML total sign, own-rounding sites). All 755 tests pass; tools/audit.py has one remaining failure in rule 6.2 because its case expects a 3-month look-back while docs/conventions.md section 6.2 specifies six months (MAX_LOOKBACK), so I followed the document.
